claims.statement: Tools | JPA Buddy | DTO Declaration offers settings for serializable type, class name postfix, Lombok use, comment link regexp, class name regexp and class comment.
An empty comment link regexp disables comment-based entity association.
claims.supports: feature is disabled when the field is empty

claims.statement: A class name regexp associates a DTO with its entity by class name for projects with a mandatory DTO naming convention.
claims.supports: class name regexp useful for obligatory naming convention

undocumented: exact placeholder syntax and serializable type semantics
